The `logsmatch` connector can be used to count log records matching a regular expression.

## Configuration

If you are not already familiar with connectors, you may find it helpful to first visit the [Connectors README].

### Default Configuration

The `logsmatch` connector may be used without any configuration settings. The following table describes the
default behavior of the connector.

| [Exporter Pipeline Type] | Description                         | Default Metric Names                         |
| ------------------------ | ----------------------------------- | -------------------------------------------- |
| logs                     | Counts all log records.             | `log.record.match.count`                     |

For example, in the following configuration the connector will count all log records from the `logs/in` pipeline
and emit a metric called `log.record.match.count` onto the `metrics/out` pipeline.

```yaml
receivers:
	foo:
exporters:
	bar:
connectors:
	count:

service:
	pipelines:
		logs/in:
			receivers: [foo]
			exporters: [count]
		metrics/out:
			receivers: [count]
			exporters: [bar]
```
